svg.title: Control Studio validates PI and PI with feedforward on the draw-off
svg.desc: In Control Studio's validation the 10-kilowatt draw-off makes candidate B raise its command at once from 60 to 65 percent, and its heaters fall only 0.185 and 0.178 degrees Celsius, the dip during the 1-second delivery delay. Candidate A, PI alone, waits for an error and falls 0.593 degrees Celsius at 8 kilowatts per degree Celsius, beyond the 0.3-degree limit. B passes every case and is applied.
svg.text: Control Studio validates PI and PI with feedforward on the draw-off
Control Studio's validation of this project · 10 kW draw-off at 35 °C on heaters with 8 and 12 kW/°C · numbers answer the predictions
A falls 0.593 °C at 8 kW/°C (0.488 °C at 12): fails the 0.3 °C limit
B falls 0.185 °C at 8 kW/°C and 0.178 °C at 12: the delay dip
Studio validates B on every case and A fails the draw-offs: B is applied
